About Lumière

Beauty is personal.

At Lumière Beauty Studio, we believe that true beauty comes from understanding the individual. Every face tells a story, every style reflects a personality, and every visit should leave you feeling more like yourself — only elevated.

Our team of experienced professionals combines technical expertise with a genuine passion for making you feel confident, cared for, and completely at ease.
